title: H.J.Res. 44 (118th Congress, 1st Session): congressional disapproval of ATF rule "Factoring Criteria for Firearms with Attached `Stabilizing Braces'" (as passed the House)
operative_text: Resolving clause (entire operative text): Resolved by the Senate and House of Representatives of the United States of America in Congress assembled, That Congress disapproves the rule submitted by the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms, and Explosives relating to ``Factoring Criteria for Firearms with Attached `Stabilizing Braces''' (ATF final rule 2021R- 08F), and such rule shall have no force or effect.
higher_law_duty: Congressional Review Act, chapter 8 of title 5 (per reader summary)
